exercises.title: Asosiy amallar
exercises.instruction: Uchta o'zgaruvchi `a = 10`, `b = 3` berilgan. ularni qo'shish, ayirish, ko'paytirish va bo'lish natijalarini har birini alohida `console.log` bilan chiqaring.
exercises.hint: console.log(a + b); console.log(a - b); console.log(a * b); console.log(a / b);
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } if (out.length !== 4) return '4 ta natija chiqishi kerak'; const [s, m, p, d] = out.map(x => x.trim()); if (s !== '13') return 'qo\'shish 13 bo\'lsin'; if (m !== '7') return 'ayirish 7 bo\'lsin'; if (p !== '30') return 'ko\'paytirish 30 bo\'lsin'; if (d !== '3.3333333333333335') return 'bo\'lish true bo\'lsin'; return null;

exercises.title: Juft/Yoqmaslik
exercises.instruction: `n` nomli o'zgaruvchi berilgan. UNVANCA `n % 2` natijasini toping. Natija `0` bo'lsa, `console.log('Juft')`; aks holda `console.log('Bo\'shlaman')` yozing.
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } const val = out[0] || ''; if (!val.includes('Juft') && !val.includes('Bo\'shlaman')) return 'Juft/Yoqmaslik matni chiqmadi'; if (n === 7 && !val.includes('Bo\'shlaman')) return '7 bo\'lgani uchun Bo\'shlaman ketishi kerak'; if (n === 10 && !val.includes('Juft')) return '10 bo\'lgani uchun Juft ketishi kerak'; return null;

exercises.title: Kattasini topish
exercises.instruction: Ikkita son `a` va `b` berilgan. `a` > `b` bo\'lsa, ikkalasini console.log orqala chiqaring, lekin `a` ning qiymatini 2 marta ko\'paytiring. Aks holda, `b` ning 3 marta ko\'paytirilgan qiymatini chiqaring.
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } if (out.length !== 1) return '1 ta natija chiqishi kerak'; const val = out[0] || ''; if (a > b) { if (val !== String(a * 2)) return 'a > b bo\'lgani uchun a*2 = ' + (a*2) + ' chiqmadi'; } else { if (val !== String(b * 3)) return 'a <= b bo\'lgani uchun b*3 = ' + (b*3) + ' chiqmadi'; } return null;

exercises.title: Kichik son
exercises.instruction: Uchta son `x = 5`, `y = 8`, `z = 3` berilgan. Eng kichik sonni topib, `console.log` orqali chiqaring.
exercises.hint: if (x < y && x < z) console.log(x); else if (y < z) console.log(y); else console.log(z);
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } if (out.length !== 1) return '1 ta natija chiqishi kerak'; const val = out[0] || ''; if (val !== '3') return 'eng kichik son 3 bo\'lgani uchun 3 chiqmadi'; return null;

exercises.title: Berilgan sonning izini hisoplash
exercises.instruction: `n` berilgan. `n` dan boshlab `1` dan `n` gacha bo\'lgan sonlar yig\'indisini toping va konsolga chiqaring. Masalan, `n = 5` bo\'lsa, `1+2+3+4+5 = 15`.
exercises.hint: for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) sum += i; console.log(sum);
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } const val = out[0] || ''; const expected = (n * (n + 1)) / 2; if (val !== String(expected)) return String(expected) + ' ga teng bo\'lsin'; return null;

exercises.title: Matematik ifoda
exercises.instruction: `a = 12`, `b = 7` berilgan. Formulasiga qarab natija toping: (a + b) * (a - b). Natijani consolestar.
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } if (out.length !== 1) return '1 ta natija chiqishi kerak'; const val = out[0] || ''; if (val !== '95') return 'natija 95 bo\'lsin'; return null;

exercises.title: To\'g\'ridan-to\'g\'ri raqamlar
exercises.instruction: `n` berilgan. 1 dan `n` gacha bo\'lgan butun sonlarni hamkorlik bilan chiqaring. Har bir sonni alohida satrda chiqaring.
exercises.startingCode:
let n = 4;
// 1 dan n gacha sonlarni chiqaring
exercises.hint: for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) console.log(i);
exercises.test: let out = []; const orig = console.log; console.log = (...x) => out.push(x.join(' ')); try { new Function(code)(); } catch (e) { return 'Xato: ' + e.message; } finally { console.log = orig; } if (out.length !== n) return 'n ta satr chiqishi kerak'; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const val = out[i] || ''; if (parseInt(val) !== i + 1) return 'i+' + (i+1) + ' = ' + val + ' bo\'lsin'; } return null;

quizzes.question: JavaScriptdagi `+` operatori qanday faollashtiriladi?
options: Matematik qo\'shish va matn birikishi uchun
quizzes.explanation: JavaScriptda `+` operatori keltirilgan qiymatlar adabiyyatini tushunadi: sonlar uchun qo\'shish, matnlar uchun birikish.

quizzes.question: Manfiy sonlarda `%` (mod) operatori qanday ishlaydi?
options: Manfiy sonlarni ham hisobga oladi, natija hech qanday alohida ko\'rinishni oladi
quizzes.explanation: `%` operatori buyumga qarab ishlaydi: ekranda manfiy sonlar bor, ular `0`-dan qisqa bo\'lsa, natija manfiy bo\'ladi.

quizzes.question: Kichik sonni topish uchun mos operator qaysi?
options: Siz `max` ifodasini ko\'rib chiqasiz, har bir sonni solishtirasiz
Ikkita yoki undan ko\'p sonni `<` yoki `>` bilan solishtirgansiz
quizzes.explanation: `<` yoki `>` boshqa sonlarni solishtirish uchun ishlatiladi.

quizzes.question: Quyidagi ifodaning natijasi qanday bo\'ladi: `10 % 3`?
quizzes.explanation: `10 % 3` = `1` chunki 10 ni 3 ga bo\'lsak, qoldiq 1 bo\'ladi.

quizzes.question: Hammasida ijobiy manfiy sonlar ma\'lumot turini qanday belgilaydi?
options: Manfiy sonlar barcha `number` turidagi hisoblashga imkon beradi
Manfiy sonlar `string` turidagi hisoblashga imkon beradi
Manfiy sonlar `boolean` turidagi hisoblashga imkon beradi
Manfiy sonlar `symbol` turidagi hisoblashga imkon beradi
quizzes.explanation: Manfiy sonlar `number` (Number) turidagi hisoblashga ijod qiladi.

quizzes.question: Agar `a = -10`, `b = 3` bo\'lsa, a/b ning natijasi qanday bo\'ladi?
Sonlarni qo\'shishda qo\'shimcha operatorlar arefati qaysiidan kelib chiqadi?
quizzes.explanation: `++` (inkrement) va `--` (dekrement) sonlarni 1 ga oshirish yoki kamaytirish uchun ishlatiladi.

quizzes.question: `a = 5` bo\'lsa, `++a` va `a++` aralashtirilgan ishlatilganda nima qiladi?
options: Bosh qismida eng katta sonni topish
Boshqacha: ikkala `++` ham a ni 1 ga oshiradi, lekin qaytarilgan qiymat boshqa bo\'ladi
Siz har bir operatsiyada ikkala sonni solishtirasiz
quizzes.explanation: `++a` (pre-increment) avval a ni 1 ga oshiradi, keyin qiymatni qaytaradi; `a++` (post-increment) avval qiymatni qaytaradi, keyin 1 ga oshiradi.
